createapplication.name: CreateApplication
createapplication.description: Grants permission to enable an account access manager instance and create an AWS account access application in the associated IAM Identity Center instance

createentitlement.name: CreateEntitlement
createentitlement.description: Grants permission to create an entitlement in an account access manager instance

deleteapplication.name: DeleteApplication
deleteapplication.description: Grants permission to delete an account access manager instance and its AWS account access application in the associated IAM Identity Center instance

deleteentitlement.name: DeleteEntitlement
deleteentitlement.description: Grants permission to delete an entitlement in an account access manager instance

getapplication.name: GetApplication
getapplication.description: Grants permission to describe an account access manager instance

getentitlement.name: GetEntitlement
getentitlement.description: Grants permission to get entitlement details for an account access manager instance

listapplications.name: ListApplications
listapplications.description: Grants permission to list account access manager instances

listentitlements.name: ListEntitlements
listentitlements.description: Grants permission to list entitlements for an account access manager instance

listtagsforresource.name: ListTagsForResource
listtagsforresource.description: Grants permission to list tags for an account access manager resource

tagresource.name: TagResource
tagresource.description: Grants permission to tag an account access manager resource

untagresource.name: UntagResource
untagresource.description: Grants permission to remove tags from an account access manager resource
